title: Whole Mouse Brain Gelation and Digestion
author: Rajvi Javeri
materials: Prepare Stock X on On ice . Acrylamide powders and solutions are toxic if swallowed, inhaled, or absorbed through the skin. It is a mutagen, teratogen and a carcinogen. Dispose of acrylamide and any contaminated consumables in a hazardous waste stream.
Swirl whole brain conical tube carefully and thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare AcX Solution
steps.instruction: Create a 10 mg/mL AcX solution by dissolving 5 mg AcX in 500 µL of anhydrous DMSO and vortexing to combine.

steps.title: Initial Brain Incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare a new tube or vial for each brain containing 3 mL MBS and place on ice.

steps.title: AcX Treatment
steps.instruction: Mix dissolved AcX with MBS for each whole brain (2500 µg per brain, or 250 µL of 10 mg/mL AcX with 3 mL MBS) and fill remaining space with MBS to minimize air.

steps.title: First AcX Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate on ice at 4 °C for 4 days, mixing by inverting tubes once per day.

steps.title: PBS Wash Sequence
steps.instruction: Perform a series of PBS washes on ice at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Replace solution with cold 1X PBS, mix by inverting, and keep on ice at 4 °C overnight.
Replace solution with cold 1X PBS again, mix by inverting, and keep on ice at 4 °C overnight.
Replace MBS again and store on ice at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Activate Stock X
steps.instruction: Activate Stock X by adding VA-044 at a concentration of 1.2% of the total volume of Stock X used (e.g., 234 µL of 10% (w/v) VA-044 in ~20 mL Stock X).

steps.title: Stock X Incubation
steps.instruction: Fill each whole brain tube with activated Stock X solution to minimize air and incubate on ice at 4 °C for 4 days, mixing by inverting tubes once per day. Save any extra activated Stock X on ice.

steps.title: Prepare for Polymerization
steps.instruction: Bring brain vials and activated Stock X solution to room temperature. Swirl Stock X conical tube carefully to avoid bubbles.

substeps.instruction: De-gas activated Stock X solution in a vacuum chamber for approximately 20 minutes to reduce bubble formation.

steps.title: Assemble Polymerization Chamber
steps.instruction: Prepare a polymerization chamber on an uncharged 1"x3" microscope slide by stacking silicone isolator gaskets to a height of 6.5 mm.

substeps.instruction: Ensure gaskets are high enough to allow about 2 mm of gel to polymerize around the brain.
Inspect chamber for dust and debris.

steps.title: Embed Brain in Gel
steps.instruction: Embed the brain in the polymerization chamber using activated Stock X.

substeps.instruction: Add activated Stock X to partly fill the chamber.
Transfer brain to the chamber and fill with Stock X to the top.
Seal the chamber with a clean, long coverslip, avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Polymerize Gel
steps.instruction: Polymerize the gel under anaerobic conditions at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Place the chamber in a petri dish and seal in two sequential zip lock bags, purging each thoroughly with nitrogen gas.
Incubate at 37 °C for 4 hours.

steps.title: Trim Gel
steps.instruction: Remove the coverslip and gasket. Use a razor blade to cut the gel into a rectangular cuboid, leaving a 2 mm border of gel on all sides of the brain.

steps.title: Initial Gel Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the gel in 50 mL 1X PBS at room temperature in a 50 mL conical tube for about 3 minutes with swirling.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue using Proteinase K (ProK).

substeps.instruction: Replace solution with 40 mL Proteinase K buffer spiked with 100U ProK (~126 µL).
Add an additional 126 µL (100U) Proteinase K to the tube.
Incubate at room temperature with gentle swirling or rocking on a nutator for 3 days (Note: Store ProK at -20 °C and keep on ice until added).
Move to 37 °C and incubate for 5+ days until the cortex looks transparent and white matter looks mostly clear.

steps.title: Post-Digestion Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the brain to remove digestion reagents.

substeps.instruction: Wash brain in ~50 mL 1X PBS briefly at room temperature.
Replace with enough 1X PBS to fill the 50 mL conical tube and wash at room temperature with gentle swirling or rocking for 2 days.
Replace 1X PBS solution for a few hours and/or overnight.

steps.title: Final Storage
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash with 1X PBS Azide 0.05% and store at 4 °C until ready for expansion.

steps.title: Vial Transfer and Final Wash
steps.instruction: Transfer brain samples to 4 mL glass vials and perform final MBS washes.

substeps.instruction: Wash sample in MBS at room temperature.
Fill vial to the top (typically 4 mL) using a transfer pipette to minimize air bubbles.
Replace solution with MBS for 1 hour, then replace with MBS again for 1 hour.
